rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon shellcode"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $x64_beacon_config = { 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 68 00 00 00 00 } 
        $beacon_http_headers = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $beacon_task_jitter = "jitter" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5a4d and ( $x64_beacon_config at (uint32(uint32(0x3c)) + 0x150) or all of ($beacon_http_headers, $beacon_task_jitter) )
}
